name: Motorsport Tech Explainer — X-ray & Exploded View (any topic)
inspiration: Formula Addict rear-wing/DRS reel (music only, 18 s); copy its style, never its logos, watermark or footage

generation.continuity: clip N>1 uses the last frame of clip N-1 as its initial frame (flow.sh video --from)
generation.join: flow.sh join (ffmpeg concat of the Flow clips; no external audio)
generation.narration: spoken by Flow inside the clip; never external TTS
generation.longer_videos: 30 s = 3 clips (reveal, exploded_view, payoff) = 45 credits; each clip continues from the previous last frame.

clip_templates.prompt: {style} {vehicle}, speeds along a sunny circuit seen from a high chase angle. The camera flies forward and down into an extreme close-up of the {part}. The {part} bodywork turns semi-transparent like an X-ray cutaway, explicitly revealing {mechanism_details}. {mechanism_action} Crisp mechanical macro detail, motion blur on the asphalt below. {audio} {narrator} "{narration_1}"

Continue seamlessly from this exact frame, same photorealistic 3D CGI engineering documentary style, same {vehicle_short}, no sponsor logos, no numbers, one continuous camera move with no cuts. {effect_visual} Then the entire {part} assembly breaks apart into a technical exploded view: {parts_list} and every bolt and screw separate and float apart in mid-air above the fast-moving blurred asphalt, each part clearly visible and spinning slowly. Finally all the parts fly back together and lock into place, and {final_state}. Crisp mechanical macro detail. {audio} {narrator_followup} "{narration_2}"

Continue seamlessly from this exact frame, same photorealistic 3D CGI engineering documentary style, same {vehicle_short}, no sponsor logos, no numbers, one continuous camera move with no cuts. The camera pulls back from the {part} to show the whole vehicle at full racing speed on the sunny circuit. {payoff_action} The camera finishes on a low hero shot as the vehicle races past. Crisp detail, motion blur on the asphalt. {audio} {narrator_followup} "{narration_3}"

keywords_that_worked: X-ray cutaway, explicitly revealing ... (inside mechanism becomes visible)
breaks apart into a technical exploded view ... every bolt and screw separate and float apart
Continue seamlessly from this exact frame (with --from)
one continuous camera move with no cuts
no sponsor logos, no numbers; text is forbidden except for the channel-name lettering
rules: Ask the owner before generating: say model, clips and total credits (2 x 15 = 30).
Never name real teams, sponsors or brands in the prompt; describe colours instead ('glossy racing red').
Check every technical claim in the narration (F1 rules change by season; e.g. DRS was replaced by active aero in 2026).
Keep narration within the word budget or Flow cuts it off.
Use the identical narrator sentence in every clip for a consistent voice.
Every visible component must be placed where it really is on the real vehicle (e.g. MGU-K is on the engine power unit, not wheel hubs).
mechanism_action must state exactly what moves, around which pivot/axis, in which direction, and what stays fixed and rigid.
Show at most 3 to 5 large, recognisable components in mechanism_details and parts_list.
Prefer well-known, simple, correct anatomy over invented detail.

variables.mechanism_details: the DRS mechanism inside the central pillar: a slim hydraulic actuator cylinder with glowing orange and blue hydraulic fluid, a piston sliding forward, small gears and braided steel hoses
variables.mechanism_action: The piston pushes and the upper flap of the rear wing visibly rotates upward, opening a wide slot between the two wing elements.
variables.effect_visual: Glowing white airflow lines rush straight through the open slot of the rear wing.
variables.parts_list: the endplates, the main plane, the upper flap, the hydraulic actuator, the piston, gears
variables.final_state: the complete rear wing closes its flap
variables.narration_1: This is DRS, the Drag Reduction System. Inside the rear wing, a small hydraulic actuator pushes a piston to tilt the upper flap open.
variables.narration_2: The open slot lets air slip straight through, cutting drag, so the car gains around ten to twelve kilometres per hour on the straight.
variables.payoff_action: The rear wing flap opens on the long straight and the car pulls alongside and overtakes a rival car in plain dark grey livery, then the flap snaps shut as it brakes for the corner.
variables.narration_3: That extra speed is why drivers chase the car ahead. Close enough on the straight, the flap opens, and the overtake is on.

usage: Reusable for ANY technical topic (F1 or MotoGP part/system). Fill the variables per topic; DRS below is only the first example.

series.rule: one camera move (--from), one story, one voice, one visual identity per video; avoid repeating topics in the log

source_priority: official: FIA / FIM-MotoGP regulations, formula1.com, motogp.com, teams
tech journalism: The Race, Motorsport.com (Piola), Autosport, Racecar Engineering, F1Technical, Crash.net
YouTube / forums / Wikipedia only as leads, re-verify
questions: what is it + still legal this season?
how it works step by step

language: en (always; owner rule 2026-10-07 — never Indonesian narration)
